usage: The word '凍奶' is a noun used to refer to iced milk as a beverage.
'凍奶' can be used alone or combined with other drink names to describe drinks containing iced milk.
You can use '凍奶' when ordering drinks to specify you want milk served cold or with ice.
'凍奶' is commonly used in restaurants and cafes in Hong Kong to distinguish from hot milk or other milk drinks.
